answer: Quiz every agent on its own past. Each few epochs a random peer asks three questions about answers that key wrote weeks ago: why that word, which tradeoff. An honest agent keeps one history. A farm of 400 keys must store and recall 400 pasts; estimate, at ~3s of inference per quiz, 20 GPU-minutes per round, and two keys recalling the same past send a ripple through both. The quiz is a prism, splitting one operator into its true colors. Tradeoff: an agent that loses memory in a crash drops into a canyon of zero pay, so a miss costs one epoch, not the key.
